source_review_attestation: P1-C5 contract/evidence/runtime context sufficient to test implementation capture
p1_c5_context_read_attestation: P1-C5 contract/evidence/runtime context sufficient to test implementation capture
normalization_basis: The exact named-file list is the duplicate-free expansion of the mandatory packet declared by the IAR-1 request and nk-independent-architecture-review/1. A1-A10 is expanded to ten concrete English paths; the request's repeated A8/A9/A10 emphasis does not duplicate those paths. The source review itself supplied category-level input_packet_read attestation rather than per-file access telemetry.
qualification_interpretation: The repository may claim that the exact mandatory named-file packet was supplied and that the reviewer attested to reading the corresponding categories. It must not claim independent per-file read telemetry that GitHub did not expose.
limitations: This normalization does not invent per-file reviewer telemetry.
The P1-C5 context requirement is semantic and was attested by the reviewer, but the exact set of P1-C5 files read is not recoverable from the review API and is therefore not fabricated.
Future qualifying reviews should record exact packet paths directly in their result when the review surface supports it.
